title: Strikethrough (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Strikethrough applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Strikethrough (BtnFormatStrikethrough) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Strikethrough toggles on and off over selected text in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: the bound driver ends green with newErrorLogEntries=0; seam verdict PASS|strikethrough|executed=True|strikeBefore=False|strikeAfterFirst=True|strikeAfterSecond=False|textUnchanged=True.

scenarios.title: The explicit strikethrough/spacing font paths are pinned as dead object-model paths
scenarios.expected: Pinned current behavior: the PowerPoint Font dispatch exposes no StrikeThrough/Spacing member, so the explicit Apply/Remove paths of Strikethrough and the Character-Spacing presets are dead code (only the native toggle/gallery commands work). Fix-forward (native-toggle readback or an RTF-level redesign, owner decision) must update the regression-ledger entry REG-TEXTFONTPROPS-001 and this pin together.
